text: Tweedledum looked round him with a satisfied smile. “I don’t suppose,” he said, “there’ll be a tree left standing, for ever so far round, by the time we’ve finished!” “And all about a rattle!” said Alice, still hoping to make them a little ashamed of fighting for such a trifle. “I shouldn’t have minded it so much,” said Tweedledum, “if it hadn’t been a new one.” “I wish the monstrous crow would come!” thought Alice. “There’s only one sword, you know,” Tweedledum said to his brother: “but you can have the umbrella—it’s quite as sharp. Only we must begin quick.
